module: Bridge between "crawl" mode (slow traversal of waypoint courses) and the flowgraph nodes / missions. It loads a trail from gameplay_crawl_saveSystem, configures it (zone, path, start position, prefabs), starts and stops the crawl on a vehicle via gameplay_crawl_general / gameplay_crawl_utils, and exposes the current state (time, points, node reached, disqualification) and the list of trails. Only one crawl is active at a time, stored in bridgeState.
usage:
local trail = gameplay_crawl_crawlFlowgraphBridge.loadCrawlTrail(trailId)
if trail and gameplay_crawl_crawlFlowgraphBridge.configureCrawl(trail) then
  gameplay_crawl_crawlFlowgraphBridge.startCrawl()
end
notes: Expected call order: loadCrawlTrail -> configureCrawl -> startCrawl; without configureCrawl, startCrawl fails ("No active trail configured").
stopCrawl and resetCrawl empty the bridge state (the active trail is forgotten).

Inconsistency: getCrawlEndData reads state.isCompleting and state.events.disqualified (field reset to false as soon as the event is handled, so almost always false), while getCrawlRuntimeData reads state.isCompleted; the more recent flowgraphBridge.lua version uses state.isCompleted and state.isDisqualified. This file seems to be an old variant of flowgraphBridge.lua.
When the crawl state no longer exists or is no longer active, getCrawlEndData and getCrawlRuntimeData return nil.
getPenaltyTypes: boundaryViolation, drivingBackwards, gateTouch, vehicleReset, wrongDirection, skippedCheckpoint, vehicleFlippedUpright, dnf.
The hook logs use eventData.time and eventData.points; these fields must therefore be provided.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: gameplay_crawl_saveSystem, general, utils, boundary, display.

loadCrawlTrail.desc: Gets a trail by id from saveSystem.

trailId.desc: Trail id (exact type inferred from code).

returns.desc: The trail, or nil if the id is missing or unknown.

configureCrawl.desc: Prepares the active crawl from a trail: resolves its zone (boundaryId), its path (pathId) and its start position (startingPositionId); the zone and the path are mandatory.

returns.desc: true if the configuration is valid.

startCrawl.desc: Starts the configured crawl on a vehicle (gameplay_crawl_general.startCrawl) and marks the bridge as active.

vehicleId.desc: Vehicle id; player 0's vehicle if nil.

stopCrawl.desc: Stops the active crawl (gameplay_crawl_utils.stopCrawl) and resets the bridge state.

returns.desc: false if there was no active crawl.

resetCrawl.desc: Resets the crawler data, teleports the vehicle to the trail's start position (orientation of the path's first node if available, spawn.safeTeleport) then stops the crawl.

returns.desc: true if the teleportation took place.

getCrawlEndData.desc: Returns an end-of-crawl summary for the active crawler.

returns.desc: {time, points, completed, pathnodesCompleted, pathnodeTimings, disqualified}; nil if no active crawl.
{currentTime, currentPathnodeIndex, points, isCompleted, disqualified, crawlerPosition, crawlerDirection, vehicleId}; nil if no active crawl.

getTrailInfo.desc: Returns a trail's metadata (the one given, otherwise the active trail).

returns.desc: {name, description, pathId, boundaryId, startingPositionId, pathReversed, rules, prefabs, metadata}.

isCrawlActive.desc: Tells whether a crawl is active through this bridge.

getActiveCrawlerId.desc: Returns the id of the crawling vehicle.

getAllTrails.desc: Lists all the trails known to saveSystem.

getAllStartingPositions.desc: Lists all the start positions known to saveSystem.

getPlayerTrailStats.desc: Returns the player's statistics on a trail (saveSystem).

getDynamicObjectsFromPrefab.desc: Delegates to gameplay_crawl_utils.getDynamicObjectsFromPrefab: objects of a prefab carrying a given dynamic name.

applyPenalty.desc: Applies a penalty to the active crawler, with the number of points defined in gameplay_crawl_utils.infractionPoints. No effect if the crawl is inactive or the type unknown.

penaltyType.desc: One of the types from getPenaltyTypes().

getPenaltyTypes.desc: Returns the list of penalty types.

getLastRecoveryCheckpointIndex.desc: Returns the index of the active crawler's last recovery point.

setRecoveryCheckpoint.desc: Sets the active crawler's recovery point.

returns.desc: false if no active crawl; otherwise the result of gameplay_crawl_utils.setRecoveryCheckpoint.

onCrawlStarted.desc: Hook called when a crawl starts; only logs.

onCrawlResultsShown.desc: Hook called when the results are displayed; logs time and points.

onCrawlPathnodeReached.desc: Hook called when a path node is reached; logs index and time.

cleanup.desc: Stops the crawl if any and empties the bridge state.
